title: Resolve/cluster handles IllegalArgumentException 'Unable to open connection'

timeline.message:
Resolve/cluster should handle IllegalArgumentException 'Unable to open connection' as connected=false and not display error

Fixed https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/105489
timeline.author: Michael Peterson

timeline.body:
Resolve/cluster should handle IllegalArgumentException 'Unable to open connection'
as connected=false and not display error. Scenario caught in failing IT test.

Fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/105489

having to compare the message to define the behaviour is really delicate. Are there other illegal state that are thrown? Do we need a different exception? I think we should look for a better way to do this.
This looks like a potential bug and we should mark it as such and backport the fix?
